source_name: Bank careers pages (self-published vacancies) – NLB, DBS, Banka Slovenije
why_relevant: Banks' own careers pages carry the fullest, unshortened ad text (job boards often truncate), including required experience with named platforms — the core artefact of this cell. Banka Slovenije's pages additionally reveal supervisory/reporting-system tooling.

source_name: AVK – Javna agencija RS za varstvo konkurence: izdane odločbe o koncentracijah
why_relevant: Slovenian competition authority publishes full merger-clearance decisions (odločbe) naming the parties, market definition and turnover — the hard-dated legal record of every bank/vendor concentration affecting SI, e.g. OTP/Nova KBM.

source_name: AVK – Prijava koncentracij (notification rules, forms, thresholds)
why_relevant: Defines what must be notified (thresholds, Uredba, Ur. l. RS 6/24 form) — needed to know which deals will and will not leave a public trace.

source_name: AVK – novice / press releases on notified concentrations
why_relevant: AVK announces newly notified concentrations before decisions issue — earliest legally-required signal that a bank or vendor is being acquired.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Izdana dovoljenja Banke Slovenije (incl. kvalificirani deleži)
why_relevant: Statutory publication (ZBan) of authorisations including approvals to acquire qualifying holdings in banks and mergers — the ownership-change record for the SI banking sector.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – qualifying holdings / authorisation decisions
why_relevant: For significant SI institutions (NLB, OTP banka, Intesa/UniCredit subsidiaries) the qualifying-holding decision is taken by the ECB, not the national supervisor; explains where the decision trail lives.

source_name: ATVP – Seznami izdanih dovoljenj (takeover-bid permits)
why_relevant: Securities regulator must authorise every prevzemna ponudba (takeover bid) for a listed SI company; register gives dated evidence of control changes at listed banks/insurers.

source_name: SEOnet – Ljubljanska borza regulated-disclosure portal
why_relevant: Mandatory disclosure channel for listed SI issuers (NLB, Zavarovalnica Triglav, Sava Re): inside information, significant-shareholding notifications (pomembni deleži), takeover announcements — hard-dated, non-promotional.

source_name: Ljubljanska borza – rules/recommendations for issuer disclosure
why_relevant: Explains disclosure obligations and timing, letting the collector distinguish mandatory filings from voluntary PR when reading SEOnet.

source_name: SDH – Slovenski državni holding, portfolio company pages & disposal announcements
why_relevant: SDH manages the state's stakes in financial institutions (incl. SID banka, Zavarovalnica Triglav); publishes asset-management plans, sale procedures and stake changes — the state-exit side of SI consolidation.

source_name: SID banka – informacije javnega značaja / investitorji
why_relevant: State development bank publishes ownership, equity-stake and receivable disposals; a channel through which financial-sector stakes change hands outside the market.

source_name: MGTŠ / FDI screening – priglasitev neposredne tuje naložbe (ZSInv)
why_relevant: Any foreign acquisition of >=10% of an SI company (incl. banks, payment/fintech, critical IT) must be notified and screened; decisions and annual FDI-screening reports reveal cross-border ownership changes that AVK thresholds miss.

source_name: AJPES – ePRS business register (ownership, subsidiaries, statusne spremembe)
why_relevant: Authoritative registry of SI legal entities: founders/owners of d.o.o. vendors, mergers (pripojitve), name and capital changes — confirms who actually owns a payments vendor after a deal.

source_name: CompanyWall Slovenia – entity ownership/change monitoring
why_relevant: Second aggregator covering SI vendors (Halcom d.d., Bankart d.o.o.) with change history; useful cross-check for silent ownership changes.

source_name: European Commission DG COMP merger case search
why_relevant: Group-level deals with EU-dimension turnover (Nexi/Nets, Worldline, OTP, NLB/Addiko-type transactions) are cleared in Brussels, not in Ljubljana; decisions describe the SI footprint.

source_name: NLB Group investor-relations / press releases
why_relevant: Largest SI banking group; its acquisition announcements (e.g. the Addiko bid) and post-merger integration statements are the primary signal of platform-consolidation decisions.

source_name: OTP Group corporate news (Slovenian subsidiary transactions)
why_relevant: Foreign parent of OTP banka d.d. (Nova KBM + SKB merger) announces SI acquisitions at group level, often earlier than any SI-language channel; merger of banks drives core/card platform decisions.

source_name: Chambers / CEE Legal Matters Slovenia M&A and Banking guides
why_relevant: Annual practitioner surveys summarise completed and pending SI financial-sector deals plus regulatory-approval mechanics; good annual baseline and actor-map refresher.

source_name: Slovenian law-firm M&A/competition alerts (Schoenherr SI, Škufca Law, PwC Legal SI)
why_relevant: Local counsel publish rapid sl-language commentary on notified concentrations, FDI screening and takeover rules, often naming parties before AVK decisions appear.

source_name: Uradni list RS – laws and official notices on banking/takeovers (ZBan-3, ZPre-1, ZPOmK)
why_relevant: Legal backbone: publication duties for authorisations (ZBan-3 art. on disclosure), takeover law, competition act — determines what becomes public and where.

source_name: SRB / resolution notices affecting SI bank subsidiaries
why_relevant: Forced ownership changes (e.g. Sberbank Europe's Slovenian subsidiary transferred in 2022) originate at the Single Resolution Board — a consolidation trigger no market channel announces.

source_name: Digital & Card Payment Yearbooks – Slovenia country chapter
why_relevant: Commercial yearbook tracking SI acquirers, processors and issuer structure year over year; useful to detect vendor/acquirer ownership shifts between editions.

source_name: ATMinfo.si - Stanje bankomatske mreze v Sloveniji
why_relevant: Independent live monitor of the entire Slovenian ATM fleet (~1046 units observed), broken down per bank (NLB, UniCredit, OTP, Addiko, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica, DBS, BKS) with availability percentages, a map/list view and multi-day history graphs. This is the single best public proxy for installed-base size, per-bank fleet share, fleet churn and outage behaviour - i.e. exactly where an ATM hardware/service competitor's footprint becomes visible. Footer credits openbanking.bankart.si as the upstream data source, which itself is a pointer to a machine-readable feed.

source_name: Bankart openbanking API portal (upstream ATM location/status feed)
source_subtype: open banking API / structured data endpoint
why_relevant: Cited by ATMinfo.si as the origin of Slovenian ATM location and status data. Bankart is the shared processing hub owned by most Slovenian banks and operates/monitors the domestic ATM network, so a PSD2-style open-banking endpoint here is the authoritative machine-readable register of ATM locations per bank. Structured data beats scraping for tracking fleet composition and geographic build-out (highly relevant given the pending cash-access law).

source_name: Demi Trade d.o.o. - ATM/self-service service and distribution (Ljubljana)
source_subtype: local distributor / service partner corporate site with reference logos
why_relevant: The clearest local-channel competitor found: explicitly performs installation, servicing, inspection and preventive/regular maintenance of NCR and Diebold bank ATMs in Slovenia, distributes CIMA automatic under-counter cash safes, and sells cash counting machines, currency-exchange machines, self-service kiosks, multifunctional terminals and electronic lockers - with 24h maintenance. Its site displays NLB, NKBM, SKB and UniCredit Bank logos as customers, making it a direct read on which competitor holds which Slovenian bank's service contract. This is the exact 'local distributor + service contract' channel the cell rationale predicts.

source_name: Biroservis - Bancna oprema Majer
why_relevant: Slovenian supplier and servicer of bank equipment (bancna oprema) carrying CCE (Cash Concepts Europe) and Dahle brands - cash counters, sorters, note/coin handling. Sits in the adjacent cash-automation layer beneath ATMs/recyclers and competes for branch back-office cash equipment budgets. Useful for mapping which cash-handling brands have Slovenian representation and which local firms hold those agencies.

source_name: Euronet ATMs Slovenia (euronetatms.si / .com)
why_relevant: Euronet is the largest independent ATM deployer worldwide (~55,000 ATMs, 60+ countries) and runs its own branded off-bank fleet in Slovenia, plus mobile ATMs, cash-deposit ATMs and 'business ATM' placement offers to merchants. It is a structural competitor to bank-owned fleets and to any vendor selling into them, because it converts hardware demand into an outsourced-service model. Its Slovenian product pages state what functionality it deploys locally; a Slovenian-language site confirms committed local market presence.
